wins.label: Record alternatives fundraising milestone
wins.evidence: surpassing our $225 billion target a year early...over $250 billion in Alternatives since 2019

wins.label: Durable revenue growth and diversification
wins.evidence: more durable revenues from financing management and other fees...have grown at 13% CAGR since 2019...make up over 70% of revenues in 2023

wins.label: Strong financing revenue momentum
wins.evidence: FICC & Equities financing together have grown at a 15% CAGR since 2019 to a new record of nearly $8 billion

wins.label: Improved M&A backlog and strategic dialogue
wins.evidence: M&A backlog saw a really strong replenishment and improvement in the fourth quarter...level of strategic dialogue has definitely increased

wins.label: Successful strategic repositioning
wins.evidence: We exited the market's lending business...sold our Personal Financial Management business...announced the sale of GreenSky

risks.label: Weak investment banking environment persists
risks.evidence: investment banking is operating at low levels that is an impact overall...it wasn't an A environment for our core business

risks.label: FICC intermediation weakness
risks.evidence: FICC net revenues were $2 billion in the quarter, down 24% from strong performance last year...clients are quiet

risks.label: Commercial real estate exposure remains
risks.evidence: roughly half related to CRE...office exposures from an impairment and marks perspective, we're sitting at roughly 50%

risks.label: Basel III Endgame regulatory uncertainty
risks.evidence: significant concern with the proposed rules...magnitude of these proposed changes would be felt well beyond the banking industry

risks.label: Principal investment portfolio reduction pace uncertain
risks.evidence: we don't expect portfolio reductions in 2024 to be at the same pace as in 2023...we want to make sure that we manage expectations appropriately
